title: "Learning analytics"

## The everyday decision

What can available course and assessment records tell us about learning,
and what can they not tell us?

## The evidence

The [Open University Learning Analytics Dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/349/open+university+learning+analytics+dataset)
includes course presentations and assessment records from 2013–2014. Course
resource metadata is not evidence of individual engagement. A separate
platform dataset has unresolved collection-method and provenance questions,
so it cannot establish which platform is best.

The site will publish privacy-reviewed aggregates only. Learner-level records
and clickstream data are outside the published site.

The existing OULAD inventory was executed retrospectively on November 23,
2026 using input commit
[`a51ba30`](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/online-changes/tree/a51ba30520859201319ec9efc40142153fb68fc2).
Its analysis file's recorded hash was later committed as
[`2859cb4`](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/online-changes/blob/2859cb40d9a120a86eb12d7c1407cd2f80c66c01/oulad/analyze.py);
the exact execution timestamp and hashes are recorded in the source
inventory. Its prepared report remains an excluded draft with no publication
date. A proposed follow-up uses only the course-presentation metadata table;
it has not been run.

The proposed April 1 registration audit is still unexecuted as a separate
milestone: its key and missing-offset checks already appear in the l01
retrospective output. That run reported 32,593 full-key registration matches,
45 missing registration dates and 22,521 missing unregistration dates. Empty
unregistration dates can describe students who completed the course, so they
are not automatically errors. No second result or publication is claimed.

The July 1 l06 assessment-completeness proposal remains unexecuted as a
separate milestone. Its join and missing-score checks overlap the l01
retrospective, while l07 separately summarizes submission timing. No distinct
l06 analysis or publication is claimed.

The l09 baseline, l10 split-sensitivity, and l11 platform-provenance milestones
remain excluded proposals. No predictive model, evaluation result, or platform
ranking is claimed; the platform dataset's collection method and exact source
identity remain unverified.

A future l12 source comparison remains an excluded proposal. It can reuse
existing OULAD aggregate outputs, but it depends on the still-unexecuted l04,
l08, and l11 milestones. Any comparison must keep platform provenance
uncertainty explicit and publish no learner-level records or cross-dataset
learner comparisons.
